overview_description.description:
PermitFlow is the first construction permit application and management platform for builders and owners. The company aims to streamline and simplify construction permitting. The company's software reduces the time to allow while standardizing municipalities’ building permit submittal process in a single platform. PermitFlow supports permitting end-to-end, including permit research, application preparation, submission, and monitoring. With our nationwide coverage and deep, local municipal expertise, PermitFlow helps builders obtain permits whether in a single municipality or across multiple states. 

PermitFlow is a Y Combinator graduate from the YC W22 program.

about_short_description.short_description: PermitFlow is a construction permitting software that simplifies the permit preparation and submission process.

product.name: Permit Research
product.description: A service providing comprehensive, up-to-date research on municipal permit requirements across jurisdictions to ensure compliance before application submission.

product.name: Permit Preparation & Submittals
product.description: A digital platform service that prepares and submits permit applications to authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs) on behalf of users, handling local submission nuances.

product.name: Permit Management & Monitoring
product.description: A permit tracking service that provides real-time updates, status monitoring, and communication management for permit applications throughout the approval process.

product.name: Permit Data Expediting
product.description: A service that facilitates direct communication and coordination with municipal authorities to expedite permit approvals and resolve issues faster.
